body:
The unfamiliar place is starting to feel like home, which nobody predicted.

Someone in the new city, the new group, the new routine gets their first real moment of belonging: a kitchen that finally smells right, a room where people expect them.

With the Moon conjunct the North Node, people start finding comfort in the exact territory they are supposed to be building in, and the old rooms lose a little of their claim in the process.

People are rebuilding home one good evening at a time.

The old rooms may keep their pull, but a first night of real sleep in the new place tends to change what people let the word home mean.
